verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own `edge0` CLI. It has a documented `edge0 serve` subcommand that exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, one-shot chat with flags such as --max-new and --show-thinking, and toggles such as --no-prerouter and --no-lora. However, the platform matrix lists a local CLI only for macOS, while the other platforms ship apps, and CLI documentation is limited to scattered README snippets. missing for 10: a documented cross-platform CLI, a full command reference with install instructions, agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured/JSON output), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: One-shot chat (pass --max-new to cap length; add --show-thinking to print the model's reasoning block too)
pass `--no-prerouter` / `--no-lora` to run the plain base model
macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
